Town, shops & places

cake shop noun

also pastry shop, patisserie, cake shop, sweet shop

modern

M-O s.v. pastry shop

taberna dulciāria

“The confectioner’s shop”: dulciārius, of sweetmeats, is in Martial (pistor dulciārius, 14.222, Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • cuppēdināria, cuppēdināriae f. — pastry shop

    noun, first declension · also used · modern · Traupman 174

    Made from cuppēdinārius, a seller of delicacies (Ter. Eun. 256, Lewis & Short s.v. cuppēdinārius).

  • cuppēdō, cuppēdinis f. — a pastry shop

    noun, third declension · avoid · modern · Traupman 129, 131

    Traupman’s word for a pastry shop (129, 131). Classically it is a craving for delicacies, or a titbit; the market in Rome where delicacies were sold was forum cuppēdinis (Varr. LL 5.146, Lewis & Short). We have found no ancient instance of it for a shop.

See also pastry cook, confectioner, bakery, delicatessen, sweets.
